_meta.stata: StataNow 19.5 MP, console binary (arch -arm64 /usr/local/bin/stata-mp -b), set graphics off, sysuse auto
_meta.purpose: twoway's own verdict on bad option VALUES, so dash refuses what twoway refuses and reports what twoway notes. Read by test/test_option_validation.py; the rules it grounds are the table in dash.ado (_dash_option_rules).
_meta.how: one `capture noisily twoway ...` per probe, rc and the joined message recorded; `graph query <style>` output parsed for the vocabularies (this Stata stores nothing in r() for it); `confirm numeric format` for the format probes
_meta.finding: twoway never rejects a bad style NAME: it prints `(note: named style X not found in class Y, default attributes used)` and draws with the default (rc 0). It rejects bad numbers, ranges, enums and unknown variables (rc 198/125/126/121/122/111/4026).
